viewing_check: Estimate 40-60, current bid $10. Look at the base for any seal or mark and at hands, ears and the bead necklace for chips. Unmarked vintage ones sold A$23-157, typically A$50-100; a 28cm size is at the larger end. Prices are steady, mostly 1-2 years old. Heavy and fragile, postage costly.
